title: SQL injection via string concatenation in findByName()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/UserRepository.java:L27 builds the query as "SELECT id, name, project FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'" and executes it via java.sql.Statement.executeQuery; the 'name' parameter is concatenated without escaping, allowing SQL injection.

title: SQL injection via string concatenation in countByProject()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/UserRepository.java:L34 builds the query as "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE project = '" + project + "'" via java.sql.Statement; the 'project' parameter is concatenated without escaping, allowing SQL injection.
